**Flow 1 again — saving a link, now with the real title.** Please try these two saves so you can see how it behaves:

1. Paste `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bookmark` and press **Save link**.
2. Then paste one more link of your own choosing and save it too.

Watch what happens to each item right after you save.

What you should see: the item appears at the top **immediately** with a brief *"Reading the page's title…"* placeholder, and a moment later the **real page title** fills in on its own — you never type a title.

One honest note about the prototype: it can't actually reach out to the live internet in this review setup, so it *simulates* reading the page title. For the Wikipedia link you'll see its genuine title; for an arbitrary link it shows a realistic stand-in. The behaviour you're judging is: **"the real title arrives automatically after saving."** Does that match what you wanted?

Once you confirm this feels right, I'll move straight on to **how you'd rename a title when you do want to change it** — and I'll show you a couple of different ways to do that so you can pick.
